title: Suriya's 'Vishwanath And Sons' Clocks Rs 200 Crore Pre-Release Business
excerpt: Tamil superstar Suriya's upcoming family drama has secured over Rs 215 crore in pre-release business across theatrical and non-theatrical avenues, with the film set for a worldwide release on August 14.
body:
• Vishwanath And Sons has registered Rs 215 crore in total pre-release business across theatrical and non-theatrical rights
  • Theatrical business totals Rs 90 crore: Tamil Nadu (Rs 45 crore), Telugu states (Rs 20 crore), Karnataka (Rs 5 crore), rest of India (Rs 5 crore), overseas (Rs 15 crore)
  • Non-theatrical rights fetched Rs 125 crore, with Netflix acquiring OTT streaming rights for a reported Rs 85 crore
  • The film needs Rs 175 crore worldwide gross for the theatrical side to be a clean hit
  • Directed by Venky Atluri and releasing August 14 in Tamil and Telugu, timed for India's Independence Day weekend

Pre-Release Business Breakdown

Tamil superstar Suriya's upcoming film Vishwanath And Sons has reportedly clocked over Rs 200 crore in pre-release business ahead of its worldwide theatrical release on August 14, according to Sacnilk. The strong valuation comes on the back of Suriya's improved market standing following the commercial success of his previous film Karuppu.

The pre-release business is split across multiple territories and rights. Tamil Nadu theatrical rights have been sold for Rs 45 crore, while the Telugu states fetched around Rs 20 crore. Karnataka stands at Rs 5 crore, with the rest of India contributing another Rs 5 crore. Overseas theatrical business is valued at approximately Rs 15 crore, taking the total theatrical business to Rs 90 crore, according to Sacnilk.

The biggest chunk comes from non-theatrical rights, valued at Rs 125 crore across OTT, satellite, and music deals. Netflix acquired the post-theatrical digital streaming rights, with trade reports placing the acquisition at approximately Rs 85 crore. The film is reportedly set to stream in five languages — Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi — after its theatrical run, according to Wikipedia citing industry reports. Zee Tamil secured satellite rights for Rs 30 crore.

A High-Stakes Theatrical Target

Despite the impressive Rs 215 crore pre-release valuation, the film faces a significant theatrical target. Vishwanath And Sons needs to gross approximately Rs 175 crore worldwide for the theatrical side to emerge as a clean hit, according to Sacnilk. This means the film will need a strong run across India, particularly in Tamil Nadu and the Telugu states, while maintaining a healthy overseas performance.

The target appears achievable on paper given Suriya's improved current market standing and the Independence Day holiday advantage around the film's release. However, the real test will be audience response, as the film is expected to rely more on family audiences and word of mouth than the action-driven appeal of Karuppu.

"He never took the easy route. He could have done a safe film, but he chose something that challenges him as an actor and a person."

— Venky Atluri, Director, on working with Suriya (NDTV)

About the Film

Vishwanath And Sons is written and directed by Venky Atluri, who is coming off back-to-back successes with Vaathi (2023) and Lucky Baskhar (2024). The film stars Suriya as Sanjay Vishwanath, an aging international pistol shooter in his forties whose settled life is disrupted by an unconventional romance with a younger woman played by Mamitha Baiju, according to Wikipedia.

The cast also includes Radhika Sarathkumar as Sanjay's mother and Raveena Tandon in a pivotal role — marking her return to Tamil cinema after 24 years, following her appearance in the 2001 film Aalavandhan. Music is composed by G.V. Prakash Kumar, with cinematography by Nimish Ravi.

Producer Naga Vamsi of Sithara Entertainments has framed the story as a wholesome family entertainer centered on human emotion. The film was shot across locations including Ooty, Hyderabad, and Belarus, with filming wrapping in June 2026.

Release Strategy

The film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on August 14, timed for the Independence Day weekend, with US screenings beginning August 13. It is being released simultaneously in Tamil and Telugu, with distribution handled by Primark Productions in Tamil Nadu and multiple regional distributors across India, according to Wikipedia.

Overseas distribution spans the US (Shloka Entertainments), Canada (York Cinemas), UK and Europe (Boleyn Cinema), and several other territories. The wide release footprint reflects the high commercial expectations riding on Suriya's latest outing.
